text.zh-CN:
阴道念珠菌感染俗称阴道霉菌感染，常引起外阴阴道瘙痒、刺激和白色较稠分泌物。

- 分泌物可像凝乳，通常没有明显气味，也可能没有典型表现。
- 性交或排尿可刺痛，但相似症状不一定就是本病。
- 通常不归类为性传播感染，反复发作需要确认原因。
text.en:
Vaginal thrush is a yeast infection that often causes vulval or vaginal itching, irritation and thick white discharge.

- Discharge may be curd-like and usually has little smell, but presentations vary.
- Sex or urination may sting, but similar symptoms do not always mean thrush.
- It is not usually classed as a sexually transmitted infection, and recurrent episodes need assessment.

text.zh-CN:
念珠菌常可无害存在，环境改变后可能过度生长。

- 抗生素可改变局部菌群平衡。
- 妊娠、糖尿病控制不佳及免疫功能低下可增加风险。
- 潮湿、皮肤刺激和某些激素治疗也可能相关，不代表个人不清洁。
text.en:
Candida can exist harmlessly and overgrow when conditions change.

- Antibiotics may alter the local bacterial balance.
- Pregnancy, poorly controlled diabetes and weakened immunity increase risk.
- Moisture, skin irritation and some hormone treatments may contribute; this is not evidence of poor hygiene.

text.zh-CN:
明显全身不适不应只归因于局部霉菌感染。

- 发热、明显下腹痛或迅速加重的不适，应及时就医排查其他原因。
- 用药后呼吸困难或口舌咽喉肿胀，应立即急救。
- 孕期或免疫力低下者有阴道症状，不宜反复自购药拖延评估。
text.en:
Marked systemic illness should not simply be attributed to local thrush.

- Fever, significant lower abdominal pain or rapidly worsening illness needs assessment for other causes.
- Breathing trouble or mouth, tongue or throat swelling after medicine is an emergency.
- Vaginal symptoms in pregnancy or weakened immunity call for assessment rather than repeated self-treatment.

text.zh-CN:
首次和反复发作均需明确诊断。

- 第一次出现、治疗无效或一年超过四次，应就医。
- 未满16岁、超过60岁、孕期或哺乳期有症状，应先咨询专业人员。
- 曾确诊且症状熟悉者可问药师，但六个月内自用抗真菌药超过两次应复评。
text.en:
Both first and recurrent episodes need diagnostic clarity.

- Seek care for a first episode, treatment failure or more than four episodes in a year.
- Symptoms under 16, over 60, during pregnancy or breastfeeding need professional advice.
- Familiar symptoms after a previous diagnosis may be discussed with a pharmacist, but more than two self-treatment courses in six months need review.

text.zh-CN:
检查旨在确认真菌并排除其他感染。

- 医生询问症状、既往用药和发作次数，必要时检查外阴阴道。
- 不典型或反复时，可用棉拭子取分泌物检测。
- 不能只凭白带颜色确诊，也不能把每次瘙痒算作同一种感染。
text.en:
Assessment confirms yeast and excludes other infections.

- A clinician asks about symptoms, previous medicines and episode frequency and may examine the vulva and vagina.
- A discharge swab can help when symptoms are unclear or recurrent.
- Discharge colour alone is not diagnostic, and not every itchy episode is the same infection.

text.zh-CN:
其他问题也会引起瘙痒或分泌物改变。

- 其他阴道感染可能需要不同药物。
- 清洁产品、冲洗或皮肤刺激可引起类似不适。
- 明显气味、疼痛模式改变或治疗不响应时，需重新核对病因。
text.en:
Other problems also cause itching or discharge changes.

- Other vaginal infections can require different medicines.
- Cleansers, douching or skin irritation may cause similar discomfort.
- Marked odour, changed pain or treatment failure warrants a new cause assessment.

text.zh-CN:
治疗主要使用抗真菌药。

- 阴道用药、外用乳膏及口服药用途和使用方式不同。
- 多数在开始治疗后七至十四天内清除，未改善应复查。
- 反复病例可能需较长疗程及诱因评估，无症状伴侣通常不需治疗。
text.en:
Treatment mainly uses antifungals.

- Vaginal preparations, external creams and oral medicine have different uses and instructions.
- Most clear within seven to fourteen days of starting treatment; failure to improve needs review.
- Recurrent cases may need longer treatment and trigger assessment; symptom-free partners usually do not need treatment.

text.zh-CN:
选药还要考虑妊娠和避孕。

- 抗真菌药针对真菌，抗生素不是替代品。
- 部分抗真菌乳膏可损伤避孕套或隔膜，影响避孕可靠性，应看产品提示。
- 孕期通常先考虑局部药；不要自行服氟康唑，口服治疗需要权衡风险收益。
text.en:
Medicine choice also considers pregnancy and contraception.

- Antifungals treat yeast; antibiotics are not substitutes.
- Some creams damage condoms or diaphragms and reduce contraceptive reliability, so check product guidance.
- Local treatment is usually considered first in pregnancy; do not self-start fluconazole, since oral treatment needs a benefit-risk discussion.

text.zh-CN:
饮食管理以均衡营养和控制相关风险为主。

- 保持均衡饮食，不必因担心真菌而过度限制主食或其他食物。
- 糖尿病患者按计划管理血糖，因为控制不佳可增加风险。
- 引用的患者资料未建立可治愈本病的特殊饮食，不能把酸奶等食品当药物。
text.en:
Dietary care focuses on balanced nutrition and managing associated risks.

- Keep a balanced diet rather than excessively excluding staple foods or other foods out of fear of yeast.
- Follow the glucose plan with diabetes because poor control increases risk.
- The cited patient information does not establish a curative diet, so foods such as yoghurt should not be treated as medicine.

text.zh-CN:
减少刺激比反复清洗更重要。

- 用水或适合的润肤清洁方式洗外部，洗后轻轻干燥。
- 避免阴道冲洗、香味清洁剂和除臭产品，穿透气且不过紧的内衣。
- 性交不适时可暂停至症状消退，治疗时核对避孕用品兼容性。
text.en:
Reducing irritation is more useful than repeated washing.

- Wash externally with water or a suitable emollient approach and dry gently.
- Avoid douching, perfumed cleansers and deodorants and use breathable, non-tight underwear.
- Pause sex if uncomfortable until symptoms settle, and check contraceptive-product compatibility during treatment.

text.zh-CN:
部分人群需个别方案。

- 孕期和哺乳期应说明当前状态，以便选择制剂。
- 糖尿病控制不佳、化疗或其他免疫问题者，需要同时处理基础风险。
- 儿童青少年或年长者的新症状，应排查其他原因后治疗。
text.en:
Some people need an individual plan.

- Mention pregnancy or breastfeeding so a suitable preparation can be chosen.
- Poorly controlled diabetes, chemotherapy or other immune problems require attention to underlying risks.
- New symptoms in children, adolescents or older people need assessment for other causes.

text.zh-CN:
随访核对是否清除、为何复发及诊断准确性。

- 治疗后仍有症状，不要只是反复更换同类药。
- 记录发作和治疗时间，帮助判断复发频率。
- 长疗程由医生安排并复查效果，同时评估糖尿病等诱因。
text.en:
Follow-up checks clearance, recurrence and diagnostic accuracy.

- Persistent symptoms should not lead only to repeated switches within the same medicine class.
- Record episodes and treatment dates to clarify recurrence.
- A clinician should plan and review longer courses and assess contributors such as diabetes.

text.zh-CN:
多数局部感染主要造成不适及生活影响。

- 瘙痒、疼痛可影响睡眠和性生活。
- 反复发作可能需要更长疗程和重新检测。
- 普通阴道感染不等同于全身侵袭性真菌感染；全身异常需另外评估。
text.en:
Most local infections mainly cause discomfort and disruption.

- Itch and soreness can affect sleep and sex.
- Recurrence may require longer treatment and repeat testing.
- Ordinary vaginal thrush is not the same as invasive whole-body fungal infection; systemic illness needs separate assessment.

text.zh-CN:
预防围绕刺激和可改风险。

- 避免冲洗和刺激产品，外部保持干燥，衣物舒适透气。
- 糖尿病按计划管理；不要自行停必要抗生素，可与医生讨论反复问题。
- 反复自诊自购药可能延误其他疾病识别。
text.en:
Prevention addresses irritation and manageable risks.

- Avoid douching and irritating products, keep the outside dry and wear comfortable breathable clothing.
- Manage diabetes as planned; do not stop necessary antibiotics yourself, but discuss recurring symptoms.
- Repeated self-diagnosis and self-treatment may delay recognition of another condition.
